datasets.title: Geodata of Damage Assessment of Portoviejo City, Manabi Province, Ecuador
datasets.description: This map illustrates satellite-detected potential damaged structures in Portoviejo city in Manabi Province, Ecuador. Located at approximately 170 km south of the 16 April 2016 Muisne earthquake mainshock epicenter and using Pleiades and Deimos-2 satellite images acquired the 19 April 2016 and a WorldView-2 image acquired the 26 July 2014, UNITAR - UNOSAT created a damage site density index for affected areas in the city of Portoviejo. City analyses revealed a total of 437 potentially damaged structures of which 87 are destroyed, 83 severely damaged, and 267 moderately damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-of-portoviejo-city-manabi-province-ecuador-april-27-2016]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts compared pre-event (26 July 2014 WorldView-2) and post-event (19 April 2016 Pleiades and Deimos-2) satellite imagery of Portoviejo city to identify structural damage from the 16 April 2016 earthquake. Visual interpretation of satellite imagery changes produced a damage site density index and classified 437 structures into three damage categories (destroyed, severely damaged, moderately damaged).

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite-based damage assessment using Pleiades, Deimos-2, and WorldView-2 imagery to detect and classify damaged structures in Portoviejo city following the 2016 Ecuador earthquake.
